fireside.speaker: Dale
fireside.text: "483 wood. We need 500. The forest isn't going to cut itself."

fireside.speaker: Raj
fireside.text: "Did you see their faces? Too many angles. I keep wondering what they want from us."

fireside.speaker: Pastora
fireside.text: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"

fireside.speaker: Pastora
fireside.text: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"

fireside.speaker: Raj
fireside.text: "Why them? ...Sorry. It's just sitting there, and they're the one who has to sit in it."

fireside.speaker: Pastora
fireside.text: "Did you see their faces? Too many angles. I keep wondering what they want from us."

fireside.speaker: Sofia
fireside.text: "Did you see their faces? Too many angles. I keep wondering what they want from us."

fireside.speaker: Luis
fireside.text: "Nobody's sleeping. The sky is waiting and nobody knows what to do with their hands."

fireside.speaker: Aki
fireside.text: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."

fireside.speaker: Ursula
fireside.text: "It eats while we deliberate. The Herald feeds on our stores and we're supposed to just... wait?"

tableLines.line: "Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Maya speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 3 people under Sofia.
🧳 Thornfield has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.

💛 You hold Daughter's Drawing. Kitchen table, burnt pancakes. You told her the sun needed holding, and she took you literally — drew you carrying it with both hands. She was six. The sky changed three weeks later. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are still yours. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplift
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
